title: Calibration lineage, retention rules, and access flows for quant profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build console features to orchestrate calibration runs for FP8/INT8 quantization profiles with clear lineage, artifact deduplication, role-scoped retention policies, and accuracy-validation workflows. Goals: 1) Give teams a navigable lineage between model version -> calibration run -> quant profile artifact -> validation report. 2) Reduce storage by deduplicating identical artifact binaries and surfaces. 3) Allow org/project-level retention TTLs with overrides scoped by role and dataset sensitivity. 4) Implement a gated accuracy-regression workflow (approval + signature) for production rollouts. 5) Expose audit/logging and CSV export for compliance and SRE postmortems.
comments: 2025-02-10 Aisha Patel: Kickoff doc added to Confluence. Initial scope defined: lineage view, dedupe storage, TTL policies, role-based retention controls, approval gating for high-accuracy-risk runs. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CAL/Calibration+Lineage+and+Retention

2025-02-11 Connor Wang (PM sync): Eng asks to split work into backend storage + metadata service, console UI, and policy engine. Proposed minimal viable: metadata-first UI (no KV cache blob listing) and schedule backend dedupe for phase 2.

2025-02-13 Leah Ortiz (Design): Uploaded first mocks — lineage graph and run details panel. Design note: make artifact hashes clickable and expose 'blame' for calibration inputs. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/REDACTED/calibration-lineage

2025-02-14 Eng feedback (SRE): Recommend content-addressed storage with soft deletes and a background compaction job. Flag: large datasets with PII require encryption-at-rest and separate retention timeline.

2025-02-15 Connor Wang: Decision log — use content-addressed dedupe (SHA256-based), metadata rows per run with pointers, store blobs in S3-compatible object store with lifecycle tags. Will not store full KV cache blobs in first release (store metadata + small samples).

2025-02-16 Security review request opened: https://security.redwood.ai/reviews/CR-142. Marked as high priority for dataset-containing artifacts. Requirement: default retention for artifacts derived from customer data must be <= 90 days unless approved.

2025-02-17 Design review: Minor UX changes — add 'export validation report' action on run detail, and a compact timeline for repeated scheduled calibration campaigns. Also show diff view for accuracy regressions.

2025-02-18 QA note: Draft test plan added — includes artifact dedupe tests, TTL enforcement by role, approval gating end-to-end, and export integrity checks. Test matrix stored in drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/REDACTED
Future: After M1, follow-ups planned: retention policy UI for org admins, API endpoints for programmatic TTL overrides, and retention audit logs for compliance exports.
